notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with at least one +1/+1 counter.
description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature with at least one +1/+1 counter, adding {C}{C}.
Basri's Lieutenant trigger, creating a 2/2 Knight token.
When Knight token enters the battlefield, Renata trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Knight token.
Repeat.
